statement: The record lists **USD 18,200**, but usage × rate equals **USD 182**, consistent with prior bills. I haven’t paid it because the recorded amount appears erroneous; please confirm or have the bill corrected.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "usage × rate equals USD 182" and calls the recorded USD 18,200 "erroneous," giving the correct value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
